tagline: Digital transformation and sustainable business partner
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI reflects Sopra Steria's core commitment to sustainability and responsible transformation, a differentiating lever in public and corporate ESG-driven tenders, far beyond a mere cost item.

kpis.name: CO2 Emissions per Employee
kpis.explanation: Amount of CO2 emitted per employee, in tonnes, over the year.
kpis.description: In 2023, emissions decreased to 3.1 t CO2 per employee from 3.6 t in 2022, a -14% reduction, driven by the shift to electric mobility.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction due to fleet electrification.

kpis.name: Total Carbon Footprint
kpis.explanation: Total CO2 emissions of the company (scopes 1, 2 and 3 - business travel).
kpis.description: The total carbon footprint amounted to 3,308 tonnes in 2023, down from 3,765 tonnes in 2022, primarily due to the electrification of the vehicle fleet.
kpis.signal: 12.1% decrease year-on-year, despite post-COVID activity recovery.

kpis.name: Number of Electric Vehicles
kpis.explanation: Total number of electric vehicles in the leasing fleet.
kpis.description: At end-2023, Sopra Steria (via Ordina Belgium) had 361 electric vehicles, compared to 259 mid-year and 181 at end-2022.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth of the electric fleet in Belgium.

kpis.name: Direct Emissions (Scope 1)
kpis.explanation: Direct CO2 emissions, primarily related to leased vehicles and buildings.
kpis.description: Scope 1 emissions reached 3,078 tonnes in 2023 (93% of 3,308 t), almost entirely due to fuel consumption from leased cars. Per FTE: 2.9 t CO2.

kpis.name: Indirect Electricity Emissions (Scope 2)
kpis.explanation: Indirect emissions related to electricity consumption and electric vehicle charging devices.
kpis.description: Scope 2 emissions account for 7% of the total (approximately 230 tonnes), an increase due to electric vehicle charging, which will be better tracked in 2024.
kpis.signal: Increase linked to electric vehicle charging (7% of total).

kpis.name: Remote Work Share
kpis.explanation: Estimated share of working time performed remotely (telecommuting).
kpis.description: Approximately 30% of work is performed remotely (70% in office or at client sites), compared to 50% in 2021, reflecting a gradual return to offices and client locations. Formal policy in place since 2022.
kpis.signal: Established 30/70 hybrid model embedded in corporate culture, sustainable post-COVID.

kpis.signal: Significant reduction due to fleet electrification.

kpis.signal: 12.1% decrease year-on-year, despite post-COVID activity recovery.

ai_positioning.summary: Sopra Steria adopts a measured approach to artificial intelligence, focused on supporting clients in responsible use cases. The group prioritizes sustainability and ESG transformation as primary strategic levers.
evidence: No mention of AI-related revenues or adoption of AI services in the Ordina FY 2023 report.
ESG and sustainability focus (CO2 Performance Ladder level 3) as an independent strategic pillar since 2021.
No AI KPIs (API calls, deals with AI, GenAI adoption) in the provided data.
Client-centric positioning based on responsible support, not proprietary AI technology.
